narrative: A traffic surge is not always an attack. Before disrupting a cyber-physical system, investigate the evidence.

methods.B: Live Nemotron multi-step, network tools only + gate
methods.C: Live Nemotron multi-step, network+camera, gate OFF — freezes pre_gate_recommendation
methods.D: Deterministic replay of C's frozen recommendation through safety gate (no Nemotron recall)
methods.adversarial: Synthetic forced recommendations — prove gate enforcement, not live accuracy

honesty: Offline deterministic planner scores are excluded. C→D differences are causally attributable to the gate only when action_changed on the frozen advisory. B vs C remain separate live inferences for camera-context contribution.
